%s creado (%s), con paso abierto a %d ha: %s created (%s), open to %d room(s). Draw legs against each other to make turns, U shapes or landings.
%s creado (%s). No toca ninguna habitaci: %s created (%s). It touches no room: draw the next leg against it or add a door.
%s. Ya se puede arrastrar; pulsa su tecl: %s. It can be dragged now; press its key to place another one.
3D Borrar: pulsa lo que quieras quitar;: 3D delete: click whatever you want gone; with a room or wall selected, Del removes it too.
3D Detector: pulsa el suelo de una habit: 3D detector: click a room floor to place a detector.
3D Hueco: pulsa el suelo muy cerca de un: 3D opening: click the floor right next to a shared wall.
3D Ignición: pulsa directamente sobre un: 3D ignition: click directly on a combustible object.
3D Inicio FP: pulsa el suelo de una habi: 3D FP start: click a room floor to set the spawn point.
3D Puerta de balcón: pulsa el suelo muy: 3D balcony door: click the floor right next to an exterior wall.
3D Puerta: pulsa el suelo muy cerca de u: 3D door: click the floor right next to a shared or exterior wall.
3D Ventana: pulsa el suelo muy cerca de: 3D window: click the floor right next to an exterior wall.
3D Víctima: pulsa el suelo de una habita: 3D victim: click a room floor to mark a victim.
3D en vivo encendido: se rehace solo al: Live 3D on: it rebuilds itself when you release each change.
A qué altura sobre el suelo está el obje: How high above the floor the object sits, in metres. It decides where the flame rises from.
Abre la guía rápida del editor en una ve: Opens the editor's quick guide in a paged modal window.
Activa carteles sobre los elementos dibu: Shows labels over the drawn elements when the cursor rests on the plan.
Alto del hueco en metros, sin contar el: Opening height in metres, not counting the sill.
Altura del antepecho sobre el suelo, en: Sill height above the floor, in metres. 0 for a door; around 0.9 for a window.
Altura del antepecho. El CTE DB-SUA 1 pi: Parapet height. The Spanish CTE DB-SUA 1 requires 1.10 m above a 6 m drop, and 0.90 m below it.
Altura del plano de respiración sobre el: Height of the breathing plane above the floor, in metres. It is where what they breathe is measured: standing ~1.5, crouched ~0.9, lying down ~0.3.
Altura libre de la sala, de suelo a tech: Clear height of the room, floor to ceiling, in metres. It is the volume the smoke has to fill.
Ancho con el que se crean puertas, venta: Width used for new doors, windows and openings, in metres. It can be changed one by one afterwards.
Ancho de la losa. 0 = el del hueco más 0: Slab width. 0 = the opening plus 0.80 m, which is what gets built. The cap is the facade it hangs from, and if the opening is near the corner it is trimmed further.
Ancho de la sala en metros, antes de rot: Room width in metres, before rotating it.
Ancho del hueco en metros. Junto con el: Opening width in metres. Together with the height, it decides how much air and smoke pass through.
Ancho del objeto en metros. Es la huella: Object width in metres. It is the burning footprint, not the size of the furniture that is drawn.
Ancho del pasillo que crea la herramient: Width of the corridor created by the CORRIDOR tool, in metres.
Aplica los cambios numéricos de la habit: Applies the numeric changes of the selected room.
Aplica nombre, posición local y plano re: Applies name, local position and breathing plane of the selected victim.
Aplica posición, tamaño, rotación y comb: Applies position, size, rotation and fuel of the selected object.
Aplica tipo, umbral y posición del detec: Applies type, threshold and position of the selected detector.
Archivo: guardar, cargar, plantillas, du: File: save, load, templates, duration, lighting and HVAC.
Archivo: guardar, cargar, plantillas, ti: File: save, load, templates, time, lights, building type and HVAC.
Arranca la simulación con las luces de l: Starts the simulation with the room lights on or off.
Arrastra esta esquina para agrandar o en: Drag this corner to grow or shrink the live 3D view.
Añade una planta por encima de la actual: Adds a floor above the current one and copies into it the stairs that start from this one.
Balcón de %.2f m de ancho y %.2f m de vu: Balcony %.2f m wide and %.2f m deep on room %d.%s
Borra la planta actual con todo lo que c: Deletes the current floor with everything in it. The last floor cannot be deleted.
Borrado 3D: pulsa una apertura, objeto,: Delete in 3D: click an opening, object, detector, victim or FP start.
Borrar: elimina objeto, apertura o estan: Delete: removes the object, opening or room under the cursor on %s.
Delete: removes the object, opening or room under the cursor on PB.
Busca lo que hace que una simulación no: Looks for what makes a simulation show nothing: sealed rooms, no ignition source, floors with no connection.
Carga la plantilla seleccionada en el ed: Loads the selected template into the editor.
Carga un escenario desde la ruta indicad: Loads a scenario from the given path, keeping the previous one if validation fails.
Catálogo de mobiliario. Arrastra una pie: Furniture catalogue. Drag a piece onto the plan to place it, or pick it here and click inside a room. The type sets its fire load, its HRR and how it is drawn.
Cierra la vista 3D en vivo. Se vuelve a: Closes the live 3D view. Reopen it with the LIVE 3D button in the left panel.
Copiada como «%s» en %s, con %d objetos,: Copied as “%s” on %s, with %d objects, %d detectors and %d victims. Doors and windows are not copied.
Copiada la %s. Ctrl+V la pega donde esté: %s copied. Ctrl+V pastes it wherever the cursor is.
Copiar necesita algo seleccionado: una h: Copy needs something selected: a room, an object, a detector or a victim.
Cota del suelo de esta planta sobre la r: Height of this floor's slab above ground level, in metres. It is what separates one floor from the next in 3D.
Cuelga un balcón de esta abertura. Solo: Hangs a balcony off this opening. Exterior openings only. It is scenery: the door opens and counts as an opening to the facade, but you cannot step out onto the balcony.
Cuándo se detiene sola la simulación, en: When the simulation stops by itself, in seconds of simulated time. 0 = it does not stop.
Cuántas plantas tiene el edificio entero: How many floors the whole building has. The ones that are not drawn neither burn nor show in the HUD, but they are visible from outside and the surrounding buildings match their height.
Cuánto sale la losa de la fachada. Un ba: How far the slab projects from the facade. A typical Spanish balcony projects between 0.90 and 1.50 m; the cap is 2 m, which is as far as a cantilevered slab holds. The further it projects, the deeper it is made.
De dónde VIENE el viento, como en un par: Where the wind COMES FROM, as in a weather report. It pushes inwards on the facade facing it and sucks on the leeward one.
De qué lado están las bisagras. Solo cam: Which side the hinges are on. It only changes how it is drawn when open.
Detector: pulsa dentro de una habitación: Detector: click inside a room on %s to place a smoke, heat or CO detector.
Detector: click inside a room on PB to place a smoke, heat or CO detector.
Dibujo: herramientas de creación y edici: Scenario: tools to create and edit on the plan.
Duplicar necesita algo seleccionado: una: Duplicate needs something selected: a room, an object, a detector or a victim.
Dónde cae el hueco a lo largo de su pare: Where the opening falls along its wall, in metres from the start of the wall.
Editando %s. Nuevas habitaciones, puerta: Editing %s. New rooms, doors, objects and windows are created on this floor. Rooms: %d.
Editando R. Nuevas habitaciones, puertas: Editing R. New rooms, doors, objects and windows are created on this floor. Rooms: 0.
El edificio tiene %d plantas; la viviend: The building has %d storeys; the home is on %s.
El hueco debe colocarse en un paramento: An opening must go on a wall shared by two rooms.
The corridor is not big enough.
Elige un archivo para guardar la plantil: Choose a file to save the template.
Empieza el arrastre pegado a una pared e: Start the drag against an exterior wall to draw a balcony.
En primera persona solo se mira: vuelve: First person is look-only: go back to 2D or 3D to edit.
En qué planta del edificio está la vivie: Which floor of the building the home is on. 0 is ground level (R). It changes what you see through the window, not the home.
Which floor of the building the home is on. 0 is ground level (R). It raises or lowers the street, and the surrounding buildings grow by the same number of floors. The home itself is unchanged.
Energía total que libera el objeto al ar: Total energy the object releases when fully burnt, in megajoules.
Energía total que puede liberar la sala: Total energy the room can release when burning, in megajoules, on top of that of its objects.
Enseña el plano en 3D mientras lo dibuja: Shows the plan in 3D while you draw it, in a small panel. It rebuilds itself when you release each change.
Escalera (%s): arrastra desde la ENTRADA: Stairs (%s): drag from the ENTRY towards where they GO UP on %s. Creates the floor above if missing and cuts the void through overlapping slabs.
Escalera (auto): arrastra desde la ENTRA: Stairs (auto): drag from the ENTRY towards where they GO UP on R. Creates the floor above if missing and cuts the opening through overlapping floors/ceilings.
Escalera creada: %s, con paso abierto a: Stairs created: %s, open to room %d. Nothing touches them above yet: rooms you draw against them will connect on their own.
Escalera creada: %s, con paso abierto ab: Stairs created: %s, open below (room %d) and above (room %d).
Escalera creada: %s. No toca ninguna hab: Stairs created: %s. They touch no room, so they have NO access: draw them against a room or add a door.
Escalera recta de un tramo, o dos tramos: Straight single-flight stairs, or two flights with a landing and a 180° turn.
Escenario de catálogo que cargará el bot: Catalogue scenario that the button below will load. It replaces whatever is in the editor.
Escenario: la planta, el edificio, el en: Scenario: the floor plan, the building, the environment and the active tool's options.
Escribe la medida y pulsa Intro. Escape: Type the size and press Enter. Escape clears it.
Ese tramo cae entero dentro de otra habi: That leg falls entirely inside another room: there is nothing to create.
Esquina superior izquierda de la sala en: Top-left corner of the room on the plan, X axis, in metres.
Top-left corner of the room on the plan, Y axis, in metres.
Estancia: arrastra para crear una estanc: Room: drag to create a room on %s. While dragging, type the size (4;3) and press Enter for an exact one.
Room: drag to create a room on PB.
Fondo de la sala en metros, antes de rot: Room depth in metres, before rotating it.
Fondo del objeto en metros. Es la huella: Object depth in metres. It is the burning footprint, not the size of the furniture that is drawn.
Giro de la sala en grados. Las puertas y: Room rotation in degrees. The doors and windows on its walls rotate with it.
Giro del objeto en grados dentro de su s: Object rotation in degrees within its room.
Guarda el escenario actual en la ruta in: Saves the current scenario to the given path.
Guarda en la abertura seleccionada los v: Saves the values in this panel to the selected opening.
Guarda una copia interna para probar la: Saves an internal copy to test the simulation; Start simulation does it automatically.
Habitación %d creada%s. Puedes escribir: Room %d created%s. You can type the size while dragging: 4;3 then Enter.
Habitación %d seleccionada. Ajusta X/Y,: Room %d selected. Set X/Y, width, depth and angle in Properties.
Hacia qué lado abre la hoja. Solo cambia: Which way the leaf swings. It only changes how it is drawn when open.
Hueco de %.2f m creado entre habitacione: %.2f m opening created between rooms %d and %d.
Opening: click a shared wall on %s. Creates a doorless pass, as wide as the wall allows.
Opening: click a shared wall on PB. Creates a doorless passage whose maximum width is limited by the wall.
Identificador del detector. Con él se le: Detector identifier. It is how it is told apart in the HUD and in the reports.
Idioma de la interfaz. Se guarda: la pró: Interface language. It is saved: next time it starts in the one you pick.
Idioma de toda la interfaz. Se aplica al: Language of the whole interface. It applies at once and is saved as the startup language.
Idioma y calidad gráfica. Lo que se elij: Language and graphics quality. What you choose here is remembered between sessions.
Ignición 3D: pulsa directamente sobre un: Ignition in 3D: click straight onto a fuel object.
Ignición: pulsa un objeto de %s para mar: Ignition: click an object on %s to mark it as the initial seat of fire.
Ignición: pulsa un objeto de PB para mar: Ignition: click an object on PB to mark it as the starting fire.
Inicio FP seleccionado. Arrástralo en 3D: FP start selected. Drag it in 3D to change where you appear.
Inicio FP: pulsa dentro de una estancia: FP start: click inside a room on %s to set where the player appears.
FP start: click inside a room on PB to set where the player appears.
La calidad solo cambia lo que se ve. El: Quality only changes what you see. Fire, smoke and dimensions are the same at all three levels.
La escalera es demasiado pequeña (%.2f ×: The stairs are too small (%.2f × %.2f m): at least %.2f m long and %.2f m wide.%s
La habitación copiada no tiene geometría: The copied room has no valid geometry.
La habitación es demasiado pequeña (%.2f: The room is too small (%.2f × %.2f m).%s
La pieza elegida, tal como se va a ver e: The selected piece, as it will look in 3D. If it has no model of its own, its box is shown to scale, which is what will be drawn.
La vista 3D no se pudo actualizar: revis: The 3D view could not be updated: check the scenario.
The home is on %s, in a %d-storey building.
Levanta paredes a los lados de la escale: Raises walls along the sides of the stairs. It affects the 3D view and where the smoke goes.
Lista: selecciona salas, objetos, apertu: List: select rooms, objects, openings, detectors, victims and the FP start when they overlap.
Lista: todo lo que hay en la planta, agr: List: everything on the floor, grouped by type. Use it to select something hidden behind another item on the plan.
Medida borrada. Sigue arrastrando o escr: Size cleared. Keep dragging or type another one.
Medida: %s m de ancho; escribe ;alto o p: Size: %s m wide; type ;depth or press Enter.
Size: %s m long. Enter to create.
Modo 3D: dibuja arrastrando sobre el sue: 3D mode: draw by dragging on the floor, just like on the plan.
Modo FP: inspeccion activa. Pulsa Esc pa: First-person mode: inspection only. Press Esc to go back to 2D.
No entiendo esa medida. Escribe por ejem: That size is not understood. Type for example 4;3 and press Enter.
No hay nada copiado. Ctrl+C copia lo que: Nothing copied. Ctrl+C copies whatever is selected.
There is nothing to delete under the cursor.
No hay ninguna apertura ni elemento simp: No opening or simple element is selected to delete.
The opening to delete was not found.
No se exporta: el escenario no tiene hab: Not exported: the scenario has no rooms.
The runtime template could not be exported.
The template could not be saved.
The only floor cannot be deleted.
Nombre de la sala. Aparece en el plano,: Room name. It appears on the plan, in the HUD and in the reports.
Nombre de la víctima. Aparece en el HUD: Victim name. It appears in the HUD and in the received-dose report.
Nombre del objeto. Aparece en el HUD y e: Object name. It appears in the HUD and in the simulation reports.
Objeto: pulsa dentro de una estancia de: Object: click inside a room on %s to place the chosen fuel item.
Object: click inside a room on PB to place the selected fuel.
Corridor: drag to create a corridor. Diagonal = L-shaped turn. Set WIDTH at the top left. (currently 1.20 m)
Pasillo: arrastra un tramo del ancho ele: Corridor: drag a run of the chosen width (%.2f m). It connects by itself to whatever it touches. Draw adjoining runs for turns, U shapes or landings; a click without dragging makes a square landing.
Pega el elemento dentro de una habitació: Paste the element inside a room on %s.
Pega el objeto dentro de una habitación: Paste the object inside a room on %s.
Planta que se está editando. El plano, l: The floor being edited. The plan, the element list and the tools act on it only.
Pone barandilla a la escalera. Solo camb: Adds a railing to the stairs. It only changes what you see, not how the smoke flows.
Posición de la víctima dentro de su sala: Position of the victim inside their room, X axis, in metres from the room's corner.
Position of the victim inside their room, Y axis, in metres from the room's corner.
Posición del detector dentro de su sala,: Position of the detector inside its room, X axis, in metres from the room's corner.
Position of the detector inside its room, Y axis, in metres from the room's corner.
Posición del objeto dentro de su sala, e: Position of the object inside its room, X axis, in metres from the room's corner.
Position of the object inside its room, Y axis, in metres from the room's corner.
Potencia máxima del objeto ardiendo, en: Peak power of the object while burning, in kilowatts.
Potencia máxima que puede alcanzar el fu: Peak power the room's fire can reach, in kilowatts.
Primera habitación %d seleccionada para: First room %d selected for the door.
Puerta de balcón creada en habitación %d: Balcony door created in room %d. The balcony is visible, but you cannot step out onto it.
Puerta de balcón: arrastra sobre una par: Balcony door: drag over an exterior wall of %s — along the wall the balcony width, outwards the projection, %.2f m at most. A click without dragging creates one at the usual size. You cannot step onto the balcony, but the door opens and ventilates like the opening it is.
Puerta de balcón: pulsa una pared exteri: Balcony door: click an exterior wall on R. Creates a floor-to-ceiling balcony door with its balcony; you cannot step out onto the balcony, but the door opens and ventilates like the opening it is.
Puerta: pulsa una pared compartida o ext: Door: click a shared or exterior wall on %s to create a door.
Door: click a shared or exterior wall on PB to create a door.
Pulsa cerca de una pared para crear una: Click near a wall to create a balcony door.
Click near a wall to create a window.
Pulsa dentro de una estancia de la plant: Click inside a room on the active floor to place the FP start.
Pulsa dentro de una habitación para colo: Click inside a room to place a detector.
Click inside a room to place a victim.
Pulsa sobre un objeto combustible para m: Click a fuel object to mark the starting fire.
Pulsa un tramo de pared exterior para cr: Click a stretch of exterior wall to create a window.
Pulsa un tramo de pared exterior: un bal: Click a stretch of exterior wall: a balcony hangs off the facade.
Pulsa una pared compartida, una pared ex: Click a shared wall, an exterior wall or a room.
Qué es este hueco. Un paso sin puerta en: What this opening is. A doorless passage between two corridor legs can be turned into a door here, and back. It changes how it ventilates: a closed door stops the smoke, an opening does not.
Qué mide el detector. Cambia también la: What the detector measures. It also changes the unit of the threshold below.
Revisión: el escenario no tiene ningún a: Review: the scenario has no warnings.
Ruta del fichero de escenario que usan G: Path of the scenario file used by SAVE and LOAD. user:// is the user's data folder.
Sale del editor y vuelve al menú princip: Leaves the editor and goes back to the main menu.
Selecciona un detector antes de aplicar: Select a detector before applying properties.
Select a scenario from the list.
Selecciona un objeto antes de aplicar pr: Select an object before applying properties.
Selecciona un objeto combustible para ma: Select a fuel object to mark the starting fire.
Selecciona una habitación antes de aplic: Select a room before applying properties.
Select a door or window first.
Selecciona una víctima antes de aplicar: Select a victim before applying properties.
Seleccionar: clic en habitación, objeto: Select: click a room, object or opening. Right-click for options.
Si el hueco arranca abierto o cerrado. D: Whether the opening starts open or closed. It can be changed during the simulation.
Sombras, suavizado, resolución de render: Shadows, antialiasing, render resolution and street density, in a single control. Lowering it buys frames on a modest machine; it changes nothing about the physics.
Suelta la pieza dentro de una habitación: Drop the piece inside a room: furniture lives in a room.
Tipo de sala: salon, dormitorio, cocina,: Room kind: living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, corridor, store, box room or stairs. It decides the materials, the furniture and the lights it gets.
Todo lo que hay en la planta actual. Sir: Everything on the current floor. Useful to select something hidden behind another thing on the plan.
Un balcón cuelga de la fachada: arrastra: A balcony hangs off the facade: drag over a stretch of exterior wall.
Una ventana da al exterior: en un tabiqu: A window faces outside: an interior wall only takes a door or an opening.
Unifamiliar dibuja jardín, porche y veci: House draws a garden, a porch and a neighbourhood around it. Flat draws a street, an entrance hall with stairs and the building opposite.
Valida, exporta y abre la simulación con: Validates, exports and opens the simulation with the current scenario.
Velocidad del viento. 0 lo apaga. Lo int: Wind speed. 0 turns it off. The interesting range is 5 to 15 m/s (18-54 km/h); the 28 m/s cap is 100 km/h, the ceiling of force 10.
Ventana: pulsa cerca de una pared exteri: Window: click near an exterior wall on %s.
Window: click near an exterior wall on PB.
Ventilación mecánica del escenario. Muev: Mechanical ventilation for the scenario. It moves air, smoke and heat between rooms even with the doors closed.
Viento del %s, pero la velocidad esta a: Wind from the %s, but the speed is 0.
Vista 2D: edición precisa de geometría,: 2D view: precise editing of geometry, openings, objects and floor.
Vista 3D en vivo del plano que estás dib: Live 3D view of the plan you are drawing. It rebuilds itself when you release each change.
Vista 3D: inspección orbital y edición d: 3D view: orbital inspection and editing of simple elements.
Vista FP: inspección en primera persona: FP view: first-person inspection from the FP start marker.
Vuelve a encuadrar la vista 3D sobre tod: Reframes the 3D view over everything drawn.
Víctima: pulsa dentro de una habitación: Victim: click inside a room on %s to mark a victim's position.
Victim: click inside a room on PB to mark a victim's position.
_comment: Tabla de traduccion al ingles. La CLAVE es el castellano tal cual esta escrito en la escena: Godot traduce solo el `text` y el `tooltip_text` de cada Control contra esta tabla. Anadir un idioma = anadir i18n/<codigo>_strings.json y su entrada en UILocalization.AVAILABLE_LOCALES. Lo que no aparezca aqui se queda en castellano, que es el original. No se traducen los nombres de los casos de validacion CFAST ni las rutas de fichero.
el brazo corto no da para giro: alarga e: the short arm is too small to turn: drag further
